name: PhantomCapsule
scope: public reusable capsule template and interactive viewer

relations.🪞幻影膠囊: no-extension public capsule file with interactive projection and explicit public boundary
relations.📖說明書即解析器.md: public bridge manual for environments without the dedicated parser
relations.SHA256SUMS: verifies the listed public artifacts other than SHA256SUMS itself
relations.MANIFEST.json: declares required artifacts, relationships, and public boundary flags
relations.ReverseChain.json: records the return chain to 🧩LKMINI and A=A

public_statement: This repository contains a public PhantomCapsule template and viewer only. Private core data, credentials, internal research method, private Drive paths, and task receipts are excluded.
